name: water
processing: Center crop 2px top/bottom, silent H264 CRF17, no frame interpolation, no speed change, no upscale
cost: local GPU only; no paid API

review.method: All 31 decoded chronological samples at 6fps plus full decode; no audio in asset
review.observations: Quiet multi-strand current maintains its lower-third route while individual amber/ivory filaments flow and curling eddies change gradually. Upper half remains dark. No sampled letters, objects, jump cuts or strong flashes.
review.limitations: Motion is restrained, suitable for rest, and must not be the only scene activity. It crosses left/right frame edges, so a mask or full-width continuation is mandatory. Sparse frames do not certify every frame or full-speed smoothness.
review.recommendedComposite: Screen with soft left/right edge mask or full-width continuous canvas; match coded current line to main wave at y65-75 percent. Place canonical lyric high in the empty dark region and keep meaningful word/line motion active.
